title: Security changes
description: Changes to accounts, privilege sets, extended privileges and file access authorizations — kept apart from the development activity, with changes made by end users at runtime and by tools marked, the mass events that touched the security model and the stamps of the security catalogs.
author: fm-lab core

params.name: type
params.description: Security object types, comma-separated (default: Account, Authorization, ExtendedPrivilege, PrivilegeSet).

params.name: person
params.description: Person key from v_change_meta_authors (spelling variants merged).

params.name: days
params.description: Period counted back from the data state: 7, 30, 90, 365 or all (default).

params.name: actor
params.description: Kind of author: all (default), developer, runtime (end users at runtime) or tool.

params.name: q
params.description: Search term over object name, type, file and person.

params.name: bulk
params.description: Mass events in the list: hide (default) or include.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of a drill-down window (local time, inclusive); wins over days.

params.name: to
params.description: End of a drill-down window (local time, inclusive).

params.name: page
params.description: Page of the change list (1-based, 100 rows per page).
